close.title: Book more estimates.
close.caption: I'd track how fast requests get booked, how many booked visits happen, and how much office time each request takes.

metrics.name: Time to a booked visit
metrics.definition: Time from a homeowner's first quote request to a booked estimate visit, measured across all new requests in the same period.

metrics.name: Visits that happen
metrics.definition: Booked estimate visits marked as completed, divided by all booked estimate visits due in the same period. Cancellations made ahead of the agreed cutoff are counted separately.

metrics.name: Office time per request
metrics.aim: Less office time on each new request
metrics.definition: Staff minutes spent on calls, texts and calendar updates for each new request until the visit is booked, excluding the visit itself and the initial account setup.
